sourceDecisions: news2 and spec2 remain qualifying tags under the owner-approved issue #60 rule; 坑道 1277390 carries both.
培養 1473360 is the primary 培 support and carries news1. 培う 1473350 also carries news2/spec2, is directly attested for つちか.う, and remains a documented unselected reading rather than a second article.

培養 and 教養 retain separate word articles but are directly excluded from each other's quiz choices because their displayed titles overlap; the new 培養 article contrasts biological or figurative growth with a person's cultivated knowledge.

堕落 and 低下 retain separate word articles but are directly excluded from each other's quiz choices because their displayed titles overlap; the new 堕落 article distinguishes a fall into a worse state from a neutral measured decrease.
堀, 濠 and 壕 share JMdict entry 1522060 and reading ほり. Keep words/濠.md and its N3 identity; link it to the new 堀 card and state that 堀 is the everyday spelling.
堪 uses two separate JMdict families for たえる and こらえる despite their shared possible spelling 堪える. Map the kana-headed articles with spelling 堪える.
The 嚇 spellings 嚇す and 嚇かす are marked rarely used in JMdict; neither is the primary support article.
建坪率 1714380 is ateji and does not establish a general ヘイ reading for 坪. 堪能 1211370 with reading たんのう is also marked ateji.
